clauses.current_legal_basis: The approval of the seal as the official seal of the Environmental Protection Agency in the order's own held text continues because the order states no end and no later instrument ending it is found in the U.S. Code, eCFR or Office of the Federal Register disposition-note searches checked through 2026-10-14.
clauses.reason: The held text approves the described design 'as the official seal of the Environmental Protection Agency' without any time limit, condition or dependent statute, and the held machine searches found no later instrument amending, revoking or superseding it, so the approval remains in force on 2026-10-14.

research_rationale:
Read the held Federal Register text of EO 11628 (36 FR 20285, October 20, 1971; text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_11628.txt) in full. It is a one-paragraph order in which the President, on the recommendation of the Administrator of the Environmental Protection Agency, approves a described seal as the official seal of the agency. It contains no duration, expiry, condition or reporting task. The held 1989 OFR codification entry and the held eCFR and U.S. Code searches show no instrument amending, revoking or superseding it; the three bounded machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121 current through 2026-10-09, eCFR point-in-time 2026-10-14, Office of the Federal Register disposition notes) report zero hits for this order, and the corpus search for its number found only the 1989 codification SOURCE line and a 2002 Patent and Trademark Office notice (67 FR 17055) that mentions the order only in passing about logo search files. The claim is therefore the held original plus bounded search route: the single approval clause is operative on 2026-10-14 because no held source ends it. Limits: the U.S. Code search does not reflect laws enacted from 2026-10-10 through 2026-10-14, and no independent source was held showing the seal is in current use.
Member checks: {"earlier_end_check":"Own terms: the order has no 'until', 'terminate', 'expire' or deadline language and approves the seal without limit of time. Later instruments: the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note search and the held-corpus search of order numbers found no amendment, revocation or supersession naming EO 11628, so no earlier end is established. No ground was found to treat the approval as exhausted by performance, because it designates the official agency seal rather than commanding a one-time act.","independent_command_check":"The order contains no independent command, delegation or direction to any officer beyond the approval itself; there is nothing separable that could survive or end on its own.","savings_check":"No savings or residual clause is stated. After the bounded searches no later instrument is found that preserves or ends any residual effect of the approval.","scope_check":"The order has one operative scope, the approval of the described seal as the official seal of the Environmental Protection Agency; the whole order is one paragraph, so the inventory of one whole-order clause is complete. The design that 'accompanies and is hereby made a part of this order' is part of that same approval."}

savings.reason: EO 11628 contains no savings clause and no transitional provision, and no later instrument was found to supply one; the approval is a single continuing designation.
